meta.title: Surrogate bids are visibly distinguished from vendor-placed bids in the QCS
gaps: Verify that the Surrogate Bid marker is absent specifically from the self-bidding vendor's header while present under only the surrogate-bid vendor's header.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Surrogate Bid marker is absent specifically from the self-bidding vendor's header while present under only the surrogate-bid vendor's header.

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow for the RFQ event.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage only.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so vendors can submit bids.
Invite two vendors so one can bid directly and the other can receive a surrogate bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first vendor submit a bid through the vendor portal.
Confirm the direct vendor bid was accepted.
Enter a bid on behalf of the other invited vendor from the buyer console.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ Master QCS containing both bids.
Confirm both real vendor columns are present in the QCS.
Verify that the QCS visibly shows the surrogate-bid marker somewhere in the QCS view.
